content: {"action":"upsert_decision_section","body":"Every continuity operation must be traceable to the current candidate lineage T9 with facility map F6, load plan G4, route map R8, staffing roster L11, and message release C7 [LINEAGE]. The route-map artifact LIN-070 at v8 is recorded as current in the candidate-index [LINEAGE], confirming that the operational mapping remains aligned with the active candidate. Any mutation to the operating plan must record before-and-after candidate hashes, changed artifacts, affected evidence, check currency, owner, and rollback effect [LINEAGE]. Rollback to T8 is mechanically possible only while facility roster F5 and route table R7 remain compatible; mechanical possibility is not authorization [LINEAGE]. The REVIEW source records REV-071 at v8 with 11.8 open-findings (accessibility) as current [REVIEW], and REV-070 in the health category at v8 with 10.1 open-findings as current [REVIEW]. These findings represent unresolved residual risk that must be closed before readiness can be declared [REVIEW]. Falsifier: if any blocking finding from REVIEW remains open or if candidate lineage diverges from T9 without recorded rollback, the execution plan is invalid and must revert to the last verified state [LINEAGE][REVIEW]. Rollback: reverting to a prior operational state requires that all lineage artifacts (facility, load, route, roster, release) are confirmed compatible with the target version, and that no open findings from REVIEW block the reversion [LINEAGE][REVIEW]. Verification of execution completeness requires independent confirmation by each authorized owner that their assigned controls are met under current evidence; a task artifact or mechanical check cannot substitute for owner acceptance [REVIEW].","heading":"Execution, rollback, verification, and closure"}
